title: my commit times vs. my sleep
caption:
my git history is a sleep study nobody asked for.

it starts so responsibly. refactor auth, add tests, tweak spacing.
then 22:41 "one more thing", 01:17 "ok actually one more",
02:10 "undo all of that", 02:53 "it's the cache isn't it",
and 03:38 "fixed. no idea how."

the commits get worse after midnight and the timestamps know it.

what time does your code stop making sense?
